$comment: Generated by `go generate ./cmd/kongtrol` (make docs) from the command tree and internal/i18n. DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.

commands.short: Connect one or more VPN profiles (or all with --all)
commands.long: Connects the given profiles and opens the live view; the VPNs stay connected when you close it. Next: kongtrol status.
commands.example:
kongtrol up office
kongtrol up --group work
kongtrol up office --dry-run

flags.usage: simulate connection flow and checks without changing system state
connect all profiles in the group

commands.short: Disconnect one or more VPN profiles (or a group with --group)
commands.long: Disconnects the given profiles and restores your DNS when the last tunnel drops. Next: kongtrol status to confirm.
commands.example:
kongtrol down office
kongtrol down --group work
kongtrol down --all

flags.usage: disconnect all profiles in the group

commands.short: Show the status of all VPN tunnels
commands.long: Shows each tunnel with its state, IP and traffic. If one fails: kongtrol doctor.
commands.example:
kongtrol status
kongtrol status --watch
kongtrol status --json

flags.usage: start embedded dashboard while --watch is running

commands.short: Show what goes through each tunnel
commands.long: Shows which destinations go through each tunnel, or through one if you name the profile. System routes: kongtrol routes list.
commands.example:
kongtrol routes
kongtrol routes office
kongtrol routes list

commands.short: List the system routes Kongtrol added
commands.long: Lists the system routes Kongtrol added for your tunnels. If one is missing: kongtrol reload.
commands.example:
kongtrol routes list
kongtrol routes list --json

commands.short: Show which VPN each destination uses
commands.long: Shows your policies with their resolved IPs, or only the destination or app you name. To understand one: kongtrol policy explain.
commands.example:
kongtrol map
kongtrol map github.com
kongtrol map app:chrome.exe

commands.short: Open the web dashboard in your browser
commands.long: Opens the dashboard to set up and connect your VPNs from the browser. If it doesn't open, copy the address shown.
commands.example: kongtrol dashboard

commands.short: Wizard to create or update your setup
commands.long: Guides you step by step to add your VPNs, policies and security to kongtrol.yaml. Next: kongtrol up.
commands.example:
kongtrol init
KONGTROL_LANG=es kongtrol init

commands.short: Validate the config and adjust this computer
commands.long: Groups the commands to validate kongtrol.yaml and set language, favorites and dashboard on this computer. Start with: kongtrol config validate.
commands.example:
kongtrol config validate
kongtrol config lang en

commands.short: Validate kongtrol.yaml without connecting
commands.long: Checks kongtrol.yaml and explains each error with how to fix it, without connecting anything. If it passes: kongtrol up.
commands.example:
kongtrol config validate
kongtrol config validate --json

commands.short: Manage your favorite profiles
commands.long: Saves the profiles you use most on this computer so you can connect them together. Next: kongtrol up --fav.
commands.example:
kongtrol config favorites add office
kongtrol config fav list

commands.short: List your favorite profiles
commands.long: Shows the favorite profiles saved on this computer. To connect them: kongtrol up --fav.
commands.example: kongtrol config favorites list

commands.short: Add a profile to favorites
commands.long: Marks the profile as a favorite on this computer. Next: kongtrol up --fav.
commands.example: kongtrol config favorites add office

commands.short: Remove a profile from favorites
commands.long: Removes the profile from your favorites; the profile stays configured. To check: kongtrol config favorites list.
commands.example: kongtrol config favorites remove office

commands.short: Set what kongtrol up connects with no arguments
commands.long: Saves on this computer what kongtrol up connects when you name no profiles. To see it: kongtrol config defaults show.
commands.example:
kongtrol config defaults show
kongtrol config defaults set-group work

commands.short: Show the default group
commands.long: Shows the group kongtrol up connects on this computer. To change it: kongtrol config defaults set-group.
commands.example: kongtrol config defaults show

commands.short: Set the group kongtrol up connects
commands.long: Saves the group kongtrol up connects when you name no profiles. Next: kongtrol up.
commands.example: kongtrol config defaults set-group work

commands.short: Change Kongtrol's language in the terminal
commands.long: Saves the message language on this computer; KONGTROL_LANG takes priority. To try it: kongtrol --help.
commands.example:
kongtrol config lang en
kongtrol config lang es

commands.short: Set the dashboard's local address and port
commands.long: Changes where the dashboard listens on this computer only, without touching kongtrol.yaml. To see it: kongtrol config dashboard show.
commands.example:
kongtrol config dashboard show
kongtrol config dashboard set-port 9090

commands.short: Show the dashboard address and port
commands.long: Shows the dashboard address and port on this computer and where they come from. To change them: kongtrol config dashboard set-port.
commands.example: kongtrol config dashboard show

commands.short: Change the dashboard's local port (applies on restart)
commands.long: Saves the dashboard port on this computer; it applies the next time Kongtrol starts. Next: kongtrol down --all and kongtrol up.
commands.example: kongtrol config dashboard set-port 9090

commands.short: Change the dashboard's local address (applies on restart)
commands.long: Saves the address the dashboard listens on; 127.0.0.1 lets only this computer see it. It applies when Kongtrol starts again.
commands.example: kongtrol config dashboard set-bind 127.0.0.1

commands.short: Clear the local setting and go back to kongtrol.yaml
commands.long: Clears the address and port saved on this computer and goes back to kongtrol.yaml. It applies when Kongtrol starts again.
commands.example: kongtrol config dashboard reset

commands.short: Turn the public IP lookup on or off
commands.long: Off by default. When on, Kongtrol asks an external service (api.ipify.org by default) for your public IP, and that service sees it; only when a tunnel connects or disconnects and when you ask (kongtrol check). The kill switch and DNS guard do not need it.
commands.example:
kongtrol config public-ip on
kongtrol config public-ip off

commands.short: Check and test your traffic policies
commands.long: Explains which policy applies to a destination and tests lists of destinations. Start with: kongtrol policy explain <target>.
commands.example:
kongtrol policy explain github.com
kongtrol policy test targets.txt

commands.short: Explain which policy matches and why
commands.long: Shows which policy and which VPN a destination or app uses, and why. To see them all: kongtrol map.
commands.example:
kongtrol policy explain github.com
kongtrol policy explain 10.20.30.40
kongtrol policy explain app:chrome.exe

commands.short: Test your policies against a list of destinations
commands.long: Reads a file with one destination (IP or domain) per line and shows which VPN each would use. If something looks wrong: kongtrol policy explain.
commands.example:
kongtrol policy test targets.txt
kongtrol policy test targets.txt --json

commands.short: Apply kongtrol.yaml changes without disconnecting
commands.long: Loads kongtrol.yaml into the running Kongtrol: policies, groups or a single tunnel. Next: kongtrol status.
commands.example:
kongtrol reload
kongtrol reload --policy
kongtrol reload --tunnel office

flags.usage: reload only the active tunnels of this group
reload only the policy engine (skip groups)
reload only this profile's tunnel (skip groups and other tunnels)

commands.short: Restart Kongtrol to use new or edited VPN profiles
commands.long: Stops Kongtrol and starts it again with kongtrol.yaml re-read; reconnects the VPNs that were connected. Same as the dashboard's Restart button. Next: kongtrol status.
commands.example: kongtrol restart

commands.short: Print your config without secrets to share it
commands.long: Prints a kongtrol.yaml template without passwords to share with your team. To save it: kongtrol export > team.yaml.
commands.example:
kongtrol export
kongtrol export > team.yaml

commands.short: Check your computer: programs, certificates, keychain, permissions
commands.long: Checks everything Kongtrol needs without connecting any VPN and says how to fix each problem. To apply safe fixes: kongtrol doctor --fix.
commands.example:
kongtrol doctor
kongtrol doctor --fix
kongtrol doctor --json

commands.short: Look up your public IP now and check for leaks
commands.long: Looks up your public IP once with an external service (api.ipify.org by default) and compares it with the expected IPs. Works only if you turned it on: kongtrol config public-ip on. If it finds a leak: kongtrol doctor.
commands.example:
kongtrol check
kongtrol check --json

commands.short: Show Kongtrol's events
commands.long: Shows the latest events from the audit log, or from the background process with --daemon. To follow them live: kongtrol logs -f.
commands.example:
kongtrol logs
kongtrol logs -f --profile office
kongtrol logs --daemon

flags.usage: show the background daemon's log (daemon.log) instead of the audit log

commands.short: Install or check the Kongtrol helper (no admin terminal)
commands.long: The helper makes the network changes that need admin rights, so you never open an admin terminal. Install it once: kongtrol service install.
commands.example:
kongtrol service install
kongtrol service status
kongtrol service uninstall

commands.short: Install the helper once (asks for admin permission)
commands.long: Installs the helper as a system service; it asks for admin permission once. Next: kongtrol service status.
commands.example: kongtrol service install

commands.short: Remove the helper from this computer
commands.long: Removes the helper; without it Kongtrol can't change routes or DNS. To install it again: kongtrol service install.
commands.example: kongtrol service uninstall

commands.short: Show whether the helper is installed and responding
commands.long: Shows whether the helper is installed, responding and on this version. If it's missing or outdated: kongtrol service install.
commands.example: kongtrol service status

commands.short: Show Kongtrol's version
commands.long: Shows the installed Kongtrol version. To check the rest of your computer: kongtrol doctor.
commands.example:
kongtrol version
kongtrol version --plain

commands.short: Show help for a command
commands.long: Shows help for any command, with examples. Try: kongtrol help up.
commands.example:
kongtrol help
kongtrol help up

globalFlags.usage: plain ASCII output (no color and no Unicode symbols)

commands.short: Conecta uno o más perfiles VPN (o todos con --all)
commands.long: Conecta los perfiles indicados y abre la vista en vivo; las VPN siguen conectadas al cerrarla. Después: kongtrol status.
commands.example:
kongtrol up oficina
kongtrol up --group trabajo
kongtrol up oficina --dry-run

flags.usage: simula el flujo de conexión y verificaciones sin cambiar estado del sistema
conecta todos los perfiles del grupo

commands.short: Desconecta uno o más perfiles VPN (o un grupo con --group)
commands.long: Desconecta los perfiles indicados y restaura tu DNS al caer el último túnel. Después: kongtrol status para confirmarlo.
commands.example:
kongtrol down oficina
kongtrol down --group trabajo
kongtrol down --all

flags.usage: desconecta todos los perfiles del grupo

commands.short: Muestra el estado de todos los túneles VPN
commands.long: Muestra cada túnel con su estado, IP y tráfico. Si alguno falla: kongtrol doctor.
commands.example:
kongtrol status
kongtrol status --watch
kongtrol status --json

commands.short: Muestra qué sale por cada túnel
commands.long: Muestra qué destinos salen por cada túnel, o por uno solo si indicas el perfil. Rutas del sistema: kongtrol routes list.
commands.example:
kongtrol routes
kongtrol routes oficina
kongtrol routes list

commands.short: Lista las rutas del sistema que agregó Kongtrol
commands.long: Lista las rutas del sistema que Kongtrol agregó para tus túneles. Si falta alguna: kongtrol reload.
commands.example:
kongtrol routes list
kongtrol routes list --json

commands.short: Muestra qué VPN usa cada destino
commands.long: Muestra tus políticas con sus IP resueltas, o solo el destino o la app que indiques. Para entender una: kongtrol policy explain.
commands.example:
kongtrol map
kongtrol map github.com
kongtrol map app:chrome.exe

commands.short: Abre el dashboard web en tu navegador
commands.long: Abre el dashboard para configurar y conectar tus VPN desde el navegador. Si no se abre, copia la dirección que aparece.
commands.example: kongtrol dashboard

commands.short: Asistente para crear o actualizar tu configuración
commands.long: Te guía paso a paso para agregar tus VPN, políticas y seguridad en kongtrol.yaml. Después: kongtrol up.
commands.example:
kongtrol init
KONGTROL_LANG=en kongtrol init

commands.short: Valida la configuración y ajusta este equipo
commands.long: Agrupa los comandos para validar kongtrol.yaml y ajustar idioma, favoritos y dashboard en este equipo. Empieza con: kongtrol config validate.
commands.example:
kongtrol config validate
kongtrol config lang es

commands.short: Valida kongtrol.yaml sin conectar
commands.long: Revisa kongtrol.yaml y explica cada error con cómo corregirlo, sin conectar nada. Si está bien: kongtrol up.
commands.example:
kongtrol config validate
kongtrol config validate --json

commands.short: Gestiona tus perfiles favoritos
commands.long: Guarda los perfiles que más usas en este equipo para conectarlos juntos. Después: kongtrol up --fav.
commands.example:
kongtrol config favorites add oficina
kongtrol config fav list

commands.short: Lista tus perfiles favoritos
commands.long: Muestra los perfiles favoritos guardados en este equipo. Para conectarlos: kongtrol up --fav.
commands.example: kongtrol config favorites list

commands.short: Agrega un perfil a favoritos
commands.long: Marca el perfil como favorito en este equipo. Después: kongtrol up --fav.
commands.example: kongtrol config favorites add oficina

commands.short: Quita un perfil de favoritos
commands.long: Quita el perfil de tus favoritos; el perfil sigue configurado. Para revisar: kongtrol config favorites list.
commands.example: kongtrol config favorites remove oficina

commands.short: Define qué conecta kongtrol up sin argumentos
commands.long: Guarda en este equipo qué conecta kongtrol up cuando no indicas perfiles. Para verlo: kongtrol config defaults show.
commands.example:
kongtrol config defaults show
kongtrol config defaults set-group trabajo

commands.short: Muestra el grupo por defecto
commands.long: Muestra el grupo que conecta kongtrol up en este equipo. Para cambiarlo: kongtrol config defaults set-group.
commands.example: kongtrol config defaults show

commands.short: Define el grupo que conecta kongtrol up
commands.long: Guarda el grupo que kongtrol up conecta cuando no indicas perfiles. Después: kongtrol up.
commands.example: kongtrol config defaults set-group trabajo

commands.short: Cambia el idioma de Kongtrol en la terminal
commands.long: Guarda el idioma de los mensajes en este equipo; KONGTROL_LANG tiene prioridad. Para probarlo: kongtrol --help.
commands.example:
kongtrol config lang es
kongtrol config lang en

commands.short: Ajusta la dirección y el puerto locales del dashboard
commands.long: Cambia dónde escucha el dashboard solo en este equipo, sin tocar kongtrol.yaml. Para verlo: kongtrol config dashboard show.
commands.example:
kongtrol config dashboard show
kongtrol config dashboard set-port 9090

commands.short: Muestra la dirección y el puerto del dashboard
commands.long: Muestra la dirección y el puerto del dashboard en este equipo y de dónde salen. Para cambiarlos: kongtrol config dashboard set-port.
commands.example: kongtrol config dashboard show

commands.short: Cambia el puerto local del dashboard (aplica al reiniciar)
commands.long: Guarda el puerto del dashboard en este equipo; aplica la próxima vez que Kongtrol arranque. Después: kongtrol down --all y kongtrol up.
commands.example: kongtrol config dashboard set-port 9090

commands.short: Cambia la dirección local del dashboard (aplica al reiniciar)
commands.long: Guarda la dirección en la que escucha el dashboard; 127.0.0.1 deja que solo este equipo lo vea. Aplica cuando Kongtrol vuelva a arrancar.
commands.example: kongtrol config dashboard set-bind 127.0.0.1

commands.short: Quita el ajuste local y vuelve a kongtrol.yaml
commands.long: Borra la dirección y el puerto guardados en este equipo y vuelve a los de kongtrol.yaml. Aplica cuando Kongtrol vuelva a arrancar.
commands.example: kongtrol config dashboard reset

commands.short: Activa o desactiva la consulta de tu IP pública
commands.long: Viene apagada. Encendida, Kongtrol pregunta tu IP pública a un servicio externo (por defecto api.ipify.org), que ve esa IP; solo al conectar o desconectar un túnel y cuando lo pides (kongtrol check). El kill switch y el DNS guard no la necesitan.
commands.example:
kongtrol config public-ip on
kongtrol config public-ip off

commands.short: Revisa y prueba tus políticas de tráfico
commands.long: Explica qué política aplica a un destino y prueba listas de destinos. Empieza con: kongtrol policy explain <destino>.
commands.example:
kongtrol policy explain github.com
kongtrol policy test destinos.txt

commands.short: Explica qué política coincide y por qué
commands.long: Muestra qué política y qué VPN usa un destino o una app, y por qué. Para verlas todas: kongtrol map.
commands.example:
kongtrol policy explain github.com
kongtrol policy explain 10.20.30.40
kongtrol policy explain app:chrome.exe

commands.short: Prueba tus políticas con una lista de destinos
commands.long: Lee un archivo con un destino (IP o dominio) por línea y muestra qué VPN usaría cada uno. Si algo no cuadra: kongtrol policy explain.
commands.example:
kongtrol policy test destinos.txt
kongtrol policy test destinos.txt --json

commands.short: Aplica los cambios de kongtrol.yaml sin desconectar
commands.long: Carga kongtrol.yaml en Kongtrol en marcha: políticas, grupos o un solo túnel. Después: kongtrol status.
commands.example:
kongtrol reload
kongtrol reload --policy
kongtrol reload --tunnel oficina

flags.usage: recarga solo los túneles activos de este grupo
recarga solo el motor de políticas (omite grupos)
recarga solo el túnel de este perfil (omite grupos y otros túneles)

commands.short: Reinicia Kongtrol para usar perfiles VPN nuevos o editados
commands.long: Detiene Kongtrol y lo vuelve a iniciar con kongtrol.yaml releído; reconecta las VPN que estaban conectadas. Es lo mismo que el botón Reiniciar del panel. Después: kongtrol status.
commands.example: kongtrol restart

commands.short: Imprime tu configuración sin secretos para compartirla
commands.long: Imprime una plantilla de kongtrol.yaml sin contraseñas para compartir con tu equipo. Para guardarla: kongtrol export > equipo.yaml.
commands.example:
kongtrol export
kongtrol export > equipo.yaml

commands.short: Revisa tu equipo: programas, certificados, llavero y permisos
commands.long: Revisa todo lo que Kongtrol necesita sin conectar ninguna VPN y dice cómo arreglar cada fallo. Para corregir lo seguro: kongtrol doctor --fix.
commands.example:
kongtrol doctor
kongtrol doctor --fix
kongtrol doctor --json

commands.short: Consulta ahora tu IP pública y si hay fugas
commands.long: Consulta una vez tu IP pública con un servicio externo (por defecto api.ipify.org) y la compara con las IP esperadas. Solo funciona si la activaste: kongtrol config public-ip on. Si encuentra una fuga: kongtrol doctor.
commands.example:
kongtrol check
kongtrol check --json

commands.short: Muestra los eventos de Kongtrol
commands.long: Muestra los últimos eventos del registro de auditoría, o del proceso en segundo plano con --daemon. Para seguirlos en vivo: kongtrol logs -f.
commands.example:
kongtrol logs
kongtrol logs -f --profile oficina
kongtrol logs --daemon

flags.usage: muestra el registro del daemon en segundo plano (daemon.log) en lugar del de auditoría

commands.short: Instala o revisa el ayudante de Kongtrol (sin terminal de administrador)
commands.long: El ayudante hace los cambios de red que piden permisos de administrador, así no abres una terminal de administrador. Instálalo una vez: kongtrol service install.
commands.example:
kongtrol service install
kongtrol service status
kongtrol service uninstall

commands.short: Instala el ayudante una sola vez (pide permiso de administrador)
commands.long: Instala el ayudante como servicio del sistema; pide permiso de administrador una sola vez. Después: kongtrol service status.
commands.example: kongtrol service install

commands.short: Quita el ayudante de este equipo
commands.long: Quita el ayudante; sin él Kongtrol no puede cambiar rutas ni DNS. Para volver a instalarlo: kongtrol service install.
commands.example: kongtrol service uninstall

commands.short: Muestra si el ayudante está instalado y responde
commands.long: Muestra si el ayudante está instalado, responde y es de esta versión. Si falta o está desactualizado: kongtrol service install.
commands.example: kongtrol service status

commands.short: Muestra la versión de Kongtrol
commands.long: Muestra la versión instalada de Kongtrol. Para revisar el resto del equipo: kongtrol doctor.
commands.example:
kongtrol version
kongtrol version --plain

commands.short: Muestra la ayuda de un comando
commands.long: Muestra la ayuda de cualquier comando, con ejemplos. Prueba: kongtrol help up.
commands.example:
kongtrol help
kongtrol help up
